sentences.text:
Ankush Kumar S/O. Asha Kumari And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...

Advocate for applicants : Mr. A.V. Hon
 App for the respondent - State : Mr. K.N. Lokhande
 Advocate for respondent no. 2 : Mr. B.R. Kedar
 ...
 Coram : Mangesh S. Patil &
 Shailesh P. Brahme, Jj.
 Date : 14 February 2024

Pc : 
Heard learned advocate for the applicants, learned APP as also the learned advocate for the respondent no. 2 and even the respondent no. 2 personally who is present virtually.
2. It appears that the applicant no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have entered into some settlement.
A joint purshis was filed in Criminal Application no. 4233 of 2019 and Criminal Application no. 4240 of 2019.
By order dated 02-02-2024 in those proceedings, the Esteemed Single Judge has disposed of both those matters in terms of the settlement.
The terms of settlement also incorporate stipulation regarding quashment of the crime.
A copy of the order passed in those applications together with the joint purshis is taken on record and marked as 'X' for the purpose of identification.

3. Since it is a crime arising out of a matrimonial dispute, we find no public element involved in the light of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2012) 10 SCC 303, the application is allowed.
4. Crime no. 75 of 2018 registered with Bhusawal City Police Station, Dist. Jalgaon for the offences punishable under section 498A, 406, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Ankush Kumar S/O.  [ SHAILESH P. BRAHME ] [ MANGESH S. PATIL ]
 JUDGE JUDGE arp/
